title: Pre/post-tool and other recurring hooks
scope: machine, project or lane according to guard authority
moment: Relevant tool, prompt, lifecycle or message-delivery event
current: Ordered tool chains enforce relevant policies, produce concrete refusals/repairs and deliver messages/launch context/advisories. Registration can recover on any observed nonterminal hook, separately from orientation. Composer caps delivery+hints+fleet report and may omit hints. Candidate fleet delivery shares age-blind scope hashes in the existing session fingerprint: hooks and watcher render only changed scopes, with an unchanged count and a full-read command. Slow paths remain full-report diagnostics. Monitor reminder and main-drift context are removed. Message batches carry one acknowledgement command for exactly the admitted bodies or stubs. Source regressions cover these changes; installed production proof remains pending.
planned: P2 expands user hooks and dedup; P3 confines project/lane guards to their scope.
proposed_content: Only action-relevant guard/refusal guidance, changed identity/readiness, required message/launch delivery, and recovery when that action needs more context.
Do not repeat the manual, onboarding pitch or full project orientation on every tool.
Machine hooks run machine rules outside projects; project and lane policies require their respective context.
If optional guidance is dropped to fit the channel, keep a reachable full-read path and do not claim it arrived.
